Tom Clancy's The Division: Extremis Malis

A licensed three-issue Division 2 prequel graphic novel that follows Agent Caleb Dunne from New York to Philadelphia and Washington as a Black Tusk-linked arms operation surfaces.

Connectionnot applicable Continuitydivision transmedia Canon scopeofficial transmedia Verificationsource reviewed Reviewed2026-07-28

A direct Division 2 prequel

Extremis Malis is official Division transmedia: a three-issue Dark Horse graphic novel positioned as a prequel to The Division 2 rather than a game mission or player-capture source. [1][2]

Story route

Its source-specific route follows Caleb Dunne after a fatal New York encounter, through Philadelphia and toward Washington, while exposing an arms operation connected to the coming Black Tusk threat. [1]

Claim ledger

Every factual statement below must retain at least one traceable source.

  1. confirmed

    Dark Horse's collected edition identifies Extremis Malis as the three-issue graphic-novel prequel to Tom Clancy's The Division 2. [1][2]

  2. confirmed

    The official edition's published premise follows Division Agent Caleb Dunne as he pursues the woman responsible for his partner's death from New York toward Washington, D.C. [1]
